subject: MAP: POC environment bootstrap — org, API keys, allowlist & VPC peering
messages:
From: Lena Wu <lena.wu@medicore.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: networking@medicore.com
Date: Sun, 7 Feb 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff — POC infra details and ask

Hi Neha / Jonas,

Thanks for the run-through earlier. Per the Mutual Action Plan (section: environment & network), we're ready to scope the technical steps so we can hit the trial/cutover target on Feb 18. Can you confirm the following items from Redwood's side and give an ownership point?

- Org creation: is there anything Medicore needs to provide (billing/tenant ID) beyond the account email?
- API keys: will these be created by us in the console or do you issue scoped keys for the POC?
- IP allowlist: we'll open a single /28 for egress, but need the exact IPs to add to our firewall.
- VPC peering: we prefer RFC1918 peers; is there a template for the peering request and required route tables?

Attached: medicore-environment-specs.pdf with our internal network ranges and contact for networking (networking@medicore.com).

If you can reply with the checklist completed and an estimated time for API key provisioning, we can lock the mutual milestones.

Best,
Lena
Lena Wu
Director, Platform Engineering
Medicore Health

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Wu <lena.wu@medicore.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — POC infra details and ask

Hi Lena — thanks for the clear list. See answers and next steps below (I mapped them back to the MAP worksheet):

1) Org creation
- Ownership: Medicore creates the org invite (preferred) or we can seed an org with a temporary admin account. For audit we ask you to provide a billing contact and tenant alias (optional but speeds onboarding).
- Action: Please share the tenant alias or confirm you'd like Redwood to create and transfer.

2) API keys
- We'll create scoped API keys for the POC (read/write tokens limited to the test workspace). Keys are generated from the Private Console and delivered as a secure link (DocuSign-style per customer preference).
- ETA: keys ready within 24 business hours after org is provisioned.

3) IP allowlist
- Redwood will serve from these public egress CIDRs for the dedicated POC pool: 34.125.240.16/28, 35.231.12.0/28 (these are ephemeral for the POC and will be communicated in the final prep email).
- Action: please add those two /28 ranges to your firewall. If you need static single IPs we can try to reserve, but it may require a Dedicated capacity commit.

4) VPC peering
- Template attached: vpc-peer-template.yaml (includes required route tables, security group expectations, and suggested MTU).
- Ownership: Medicore initiates the peering request with your cloud provider; Redwood will accept the peering from our side once we have the peering ID and the shared account/project IDs.
- Network contact: please loop in your networking@medicore.com for scheduling.

Proposed immediate milestones (from Redwood MAP perspective):
- Today (Day 0): Confirm org flow (you or us to create).
- +1 business day: Org created + invite sent; we generate POC keys.
- +2 business days: Medicore confirms IP allowlist and opens peering request.
- +5 business days: Peering active and smoke test (ping, endpoints, basic inference).

Attachments: I attached a prefilled vpc-peer-template.yaml and a short checklist (inline below) — can confirm we received your medicore-environment-specs.pdf.

Checklist (Redwood):
- [ ] Org invite or transfer method confirmed
- [x] POC key generation process agreed
- [ ] CIDR ranges accepted by Medicore firewall
- [ ] Peering template reviewed by Medicore networking

Quick ask: who at Medicore will be the day-of-networking point for the peering handshake (email + 2-hour window availability)?

Thanks — looped Jonas for handoff on the go-live cadence.

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415 555 0123
From: Lena Wu <lena.wu@medicore.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: networking@medicore.com, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 13:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — POC infra details and ask

On Mon, Feb 8, 2027 at 10:05 AM Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai> wrote:
> (quoted above)

Thanks — this looks good. A few notes from networking:
- Medicore will create the org and send the tenant alias today by EOD.
- Networking contact: Raj Patel <raj.patel@medicore.com> (cc'ed to networking@medicore.com). He can do the peering handshake on Feb 11 between 09:00-11:00 PST.
- CIDR acceptance: confirmed — we'll add the two /28 ranges to our firewall and confirm once the rules have propagated (should be within 2 hours after you confirm the exact list).

Question on egress costs: will Redwood's egress be charged to Medicore or billed separately? We want to ensure the MAP reflects expected cost responsibilities.

We'll send the peering request tomorrow morning; please confirm the exact account/project IDs and the peering request will include the route table IDs you provided in the template.

Best,
Lena

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Wu <lena.wu@medicore.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@medicore.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 16:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — POC infra details and ask

Hi Lena / Raj — thanks for the rapid turnaround and for confirming the peering window. Quick answers and next actions so we can close the MAP row: 

- Account/project IDs (Redwood acceptance):
  Project ID: redwood-poc-prod-23894
  Account: redwood-inference-poc@redwood.ai
  Please include these in your peering request and we will accept the connection immediately.

- Egress billing: per the MAP and our POC terms, outbound egress incurred by traffic from Medicore to public internet will be billed to Medicore. For inter-VPC traffic across the peer (private traffic), Redwood will absorb internal network egress for the POC up to the agreed trial volume. We will add a shortnote in the MAP doc to make responsibilities explicit.

- API keys: Neha will generate and deliver the scoped POC keys once your org invite is accepted.

Next steps (Jonas / Redwood):
- Jonas: schedule the smoke test for Feb 12 (09:00 PST) — please confirm Raj availability.
- Neha: generate keys and provide secure link after org creation.
- Marissa: will run the readiness checklist and post results to the MAP doc.

Thanks — once Raj posts the peering request ID, we'll accept and run a quick connectivity probe.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Manager, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
